title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode20 The World Hasn't Even Started Yet

meta.Episode: Episode20 — The World Hasn't Even Started Yet

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's go back and try our show one more time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? “Untitled” is flashing again?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your feelings are taking the form of a song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Songs are composed of powerful feelings, thoughts, and emotions. When you discover your true feelings, they turn into a song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup♪ This song expresses your desire to bring joy to everyone with your shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shall we sing it together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can I sing a song I don't even know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It has been a part of you all along.
It will come directly from your heart.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But it's not a song I discovered alone.
It's their song as much as mine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would it be okay if we all sang it together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We can sing with you? Yaaay! I'm so excited♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I also want to sing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A song representing Tsukasa's feelings, hmm? My interest is piqued.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, let's sing it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was our song...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I loved it sooo very much! I want to sing it again♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Me too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, look. “Untitled” is being overwritten with your song.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The title is changing?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Yet another fascinating phenomenon.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The title is now... “The World Hasn't Even Started Yet”?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “The World Hasn't Even Started Yet”... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As in, from now on we'll be building a world of wonderful shows together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You could be right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems that finally, our showtime is about to begin.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we return to our stage together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You said it!
Miku, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, um...wanted to thank you for doing that show with me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're most welcome. Please feel free to visit us anytime. We're always happy to do more shows!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, visit us often! We're always here for you☆
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? The Wonder Stage is going to be demolished?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes... I'm sorry I didn't tell you earlier.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hold on, that's only going to happen if the stage doesn't attract a large audience before school break, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In which case I can... No, WE can save it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: From today, let's do shows every day and get lots of people to come see us before the end of school break!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do this! I'm not going to give up either!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This stage will become the set for the ultimate in theatrical performance!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: One final check! Costumes and props are all fine!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No problems with the sound system, lights, or stage machinery either.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The audience this time is only half of what we had at our first show, but that's still quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I will do my best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, remember that, if anything happens, you have me, Emu, and Rui to rely on! So spread your wings and don't worry too much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll try!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay. Now, Emu, you do your thing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What thing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You know! Your signature move!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, THAT thing♪ Alright!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do this, everyone! Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime, it's time to raise the curtain!

rows.Speaker: Emumu
rows.Line: “Nyeh heh heh! I'm Emumu, the demon lord's dragon keeper! My dragon will pancake you, foolish prince!”

rows.Speaker: Kids
rows.Line: Don't give up, Prince Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Ne-Ne
rows.Line:
“Your Highness, please allow me to take care of this.
Lalalala♪”

rows.Speaker: Emumu
rows.Line:
“Ooh, what a pretty song!
But somehow it's...it's making me unbearably sleepy! Zzz...”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord
rows.Line: “So you made it this far, Prince...”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord
rows.Line:
“But look at you, you're wounded and battered.
You stand no chance against me, so why do you still raise your sword?”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “Why? Isn't it obvious?”

rows.Speaker: Pegasus
rows.Line: “To restore happiness to the world!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We hope you enjoyed our show!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone in the audience is smiling!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This means the world to me, guys!
Thank you so much! And especially you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh, that was a piece of cake...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For a star such as myself!
